        resources = observation.get('resources', [])

            dx = 1 if rx > my_x else -1 if rx < my_x else 0
            dy = 1 if ry > my_y else -1 if ry < my_y else 0

        opponents = observation.get('opponents', [])
        my_x, my_y = my_pos
        if opponents:
            # Pursue the closest opponent
            closest = min(opponents, key=lambda o: abs(o.get('position', [0,0])[0]-my_x)+abs(o.get('position', [1]-my_y)))
            opp_pos = closest.get('position', [my_x, my_y])
            rx, ry = opp_pos
            dx = 1 if rx > my_x else -1 if rx < my_x else 0
            dy = 1 if ry > my_y else -1 if ry < my_y else 0

            dy = 1 if ry > my_y else -1 if ry < my_y else 0

    return [dx, dy]
